summary:
I have successfully found the "needle" and resolved the data corruption issue!

### Root Cause & Fix
The worker segment assignment function in `src/config.rs` added an intentional overlap of `+ 2` segments for "write redundancy," causing concurrent threads to race over boundary offsets and corrupt the file. I removed the `+ 2` overlap in `src/config.rs` and updated the documentation.

### Verification
All unit tests and `./test.sh` now pass successfully.
